mentions.name: Parkeergarages Delft
mentions.description: This website records live parking garage availability data for Delft over time, so that historical records exist for public analysis and debate.
mentions.problem: Live parking data exists but nobody keeps a record, causing the public debate to run on anecdotes.
mentions.audience: Public debate on parking availability in Delft
mentions.source_excerpt: It's the same idea as my previous project (http://parkeergaragesdelft.nl) where we do have live data but nobody keeps a record causing the public debate to run on anecdotes.
mentions.author: ricohageman
